slides.title: SQL Injection kya [[hai]]?
points: Hacking technique jo DB udati hai
slides.note: Bole toh: Lock todne ke bajaye, keyhole mein liquid daal kar lock kholna

slides.title: Sample [[users]] table
slides.note: In users ka data bina password ke mil sakta hai agar query weak ho 😱

slides.title: [[Vulnerable]] Query
slides.note: Yahan variable ko seedha string mein add kiya jata hai, jo sabse badi galti hai

slides.title: Query kaise [[badli]]?
points: DB ko laga validation **pass** ho gaya
slides.note: AND ke baad wala password check ab bekar ho gaya, logic hi bypass! 🕵️

slides.title: Hack wala [[Result]]
slides.note: Bina password ke saari rows return ho gayi. Hacker logged in! 💀

slides.title: Safe [[Prepared]] Statement
slides.code:
SELECT * FROM users
WHERE user = ?
AND pass = ?;

-- ? is a placeholder
slides.note: Placeholder use karne se DB input ko sirf 'data' maanta hai, code nahi 🛡️

slides.wrong: Query string ko variable se [[concatenate]] karna
slides.why: Concatenation se hacker query ka logic hi badal sakta hai, placeholders safe hain

points: `' OR '1'='1` logic ko bypass karta hai
